breaking_news.headline: Thieves are targeting the world's copper. This phone company is fighting back
breaking_news.summary: The value of copper is rising, and thieves can make money by stripping it from phone poles, streetlights and EV chargers. But those thefts cost the rest of us.

breaking_news.headline: Firings at CBS' '60 Minutes' reflect the fight for media control in the age of Trump
breaking_news.summary: The show's new leader says he fired star Scott Pelley for insubordination. Pelley says he was defending the integrity of the show's journalism after three top executives and two reporters were fired.

breaking_news.headline: Trump strips job protections from 8,000 federal workers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump signed an executive order that puts some 8,000 high-ranking civil servants into a new category of employees who can be fired for any reason.

breaking_news.headline: A former GEO Group executive now runs ICE. The company's government ties run deep
breaking_news.summary: David Venturella's appointment as acting ICE director is the latest in a pattern: Many former employees of the private prison company GEO Group end up working at the federal agency, and vice versa.

breaking_news.headline: As Strait of Hormuz stays shut, companies seek new routes for trade
breaking_news.summary: Shipping companies are looking for alternative routes as the Strait of Hormuz lockdown drags on.

breaking_news.headline: How cellphone carriers prepare for hurricane season with AI, drones and 'cows'
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane season is expected to be milder than usual this year. But that's not stopping cell phone companies from pulling out all the stops.

breaking_news.headline: What do you actually get when you pay for AI?
breaking_news.summary: Just 3% of U.S. households pay for AI for personal use. Sign ups are growing — even though Americans have subscription fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: For many fans, the World Cup begins with a pack of stickers. The U.S. is catching up
breaking_news.summary: Collecting Panini stickers is a World Cup tradition beloved in Europe and Latin America. In the U.S., interest has been building steadily, and this summer, the buzz is bigger than ever.

breaking_news.headline: Mangrove forests are healing after decades of human destruction
breaking_news.summary: Swampy mangrove forests are staging a surprise comeback - which is good news for coastal communities and the climate.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-wife of Dubai ruler's nephew in custody, prosecutors say
breaking_news.summary: Zeynab Javadli had not been in contact with any of her friends since Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: US actor James Handy stabbed to death, with girlfriend's son arrested
breaking_news.summary: Handy, 81, is known for his roles in films including Jumanji and Top Gun: Maverick.

breaking_news.headline: Nearly 50 people die of thirst in Sahara desert after lorry breaks down
breaking_news.summary: Only two survived after trekking more than 50km (30 miles) across the desert to alert the authorities.

breaking_news.headline: How Trump's White House ballroom plan has doubled in size and cost over a year
breaking_news.summary: BBC Verify examines how the biggest change to the White House in decades has transformed in the last year.

breaking_news.headline: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
breaking_news.summary: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky proposes face-to-face talks in open letter to Putin
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president tells the Russian leader that only "direct engagement" between the two countries could end the war, with the US focused on Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Mark Zuckerberg's longest-serving employee on AI, jobs - and her boss
breaking_news.summary: Naomi Gleit has weathered many controversies at Meta, but remains in what she tells the BBC is her "dream job".

breaking_news.headline: Trump announces $700m coal investment using wartime powers
breaking_news.summary: The president is directing money into coal as the Iran war drives up energy costs for Americans.

breaking_news.headline: The ancient trick making food waste useful and tasty
breaking_news.summary: Instead of throwing away byproducts of food processing, fermentation is making them valuable.

breaking_news.headline: China cracks down on soft porn, violence and materialism in viral micro dramas
breaking_news.summary: Micro dramas have surged in popularity, but drawn criticism for often sensationalist content.

breaking_news.headline: Single 20-somethings need AI to make first move on dating apps - Hinge boss
breaking_news.summary: Jackie Jantos says loneliness and lack of confidence were challenges for young adults looking for relationships.
